text_block_list.text:
Mid-November.
One day, as the wind began to carry
the piercing chill of winter...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *exhale*.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, gh...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um...! E-Excuse me!
Is Kris S-san around?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Rob Roy.
—Did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I... I have something to talk to you about, so I came...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(It was on the way home from watching the Tenno Sho (Autumn)
that I decided to have a proper talk.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(The time from that day until now
was just how long it took me to gather my courage.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, even so, I wanted to hand it to you myself.
Looking into your eyes, facing you directly.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(All of these feelings of mine—
of wanting to challenge you.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run in this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I watched the press conference on the last day of the summer camp.
For you, Kris S-san,
the Arima Kinen will be your retirement race, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's why... *sigh*... in the end,
I wanted to challenge you, even just once.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san.
I look forward to competing with you... in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(—Without so much as twitching an eyebrow,
Kris S nodded in response.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Just the reaction I expected. That is her, through and through.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Because nothing changes.
Even if it's the end, no matter who the opponent is.
She just 'does what must be done,' that's all.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Just that, same as always——...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Is that... all...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ? —...Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Always doing what must be done, no matter what happens... I admired that about you. I respected you for that.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...And yet,
...even so.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san... why?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Why... are you going to retire...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Because I did what needed to be done.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—The meaning of running.
—My mission.
—It will all end at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Meaning... purpose...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: In that case... any regrets?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any regrets of your own?
...None at all? ...Not even a little?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —No.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—In that case, excuse me.
Please forget everything I just said.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Everything I told you earlier...
............was a lie.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!! That's right, it was all a lie!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Right. It's a lie. It's wrong. It was all a lie!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(“Just once is fine”? “Just one last time”?
“I just want to race against you one single time”?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (—Enough of your sophistry!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san.
I'll see you in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And there, I—I will beat you.
I swear I will seize that victory!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: And, nggh... I will!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure I become your one and only regret!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san, you are who I look up to.
Your unwavering composure, your steadfast sense of duty—I respect all of it. ...However!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Leaving gracefully like this is the one thing
I... will never forgive!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...Right.
That's right, I won't let it end like this.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (To end up as a nobody to her. I, of all people, can absolutely never let that stand!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "...I apologize not only for summoning you on short notice, but also for being so impolite."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I will... take my leave now.
...See you next, at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Whoa!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――!!
――Sorry. ――I was careless.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, I'm fine.
Our shoulders just brushed against each other a bit, so please don't worry—

"Bearing the same Symboli name and sharing a deep bond,
Symboli Rudolf suddenly paused in her tracks."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Hm.
I see—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Kris S. Thanks to my grandfather's connections,
I got hold of some fine coffee beans. Care to join me
in the student council room for a cup?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I shall serve some tea snacks as well. Don't worry, I will not take much of your time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I'd like to talk with you for a bit.
Do you mind?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Well then, shall we go?

A passionate emotion that had sprouted.
And the one confronted by it.
"With each competitor deep in their own thoughts, the day of the Arima Kinen draws near."
